problem.title: Booking a flight home shouldn't feel like a gamble
problem.intro: Today's OTAs were built for leisure tourists with Western passports. For Australia's international students and recent migrants, the same booking flow hides costs, risks, and dead ends.

cards.title: Visa anxiety
cards.body: A cheaper fare through a transit city can mean a visa you don't have. No major OTA warns you before you book - you find out at the gate.

cards.title: Opaque fees
cards.body: The headline price balloons at checkout with booking fees, card surcharges, and FX margin. You commit before you ever see the real total.

cards.title: Thin Asia inventory
cards.body: Incumbents optimise for AU domestic and Europe. Asia-Pacific carriers, transit combinations, and home-city routes are an afterthought.

cards.title: No student deals
cards.body: No .edu verification, no pay-later, no understanding of term-break seasonality. Students fly 1-3x a year and get treated like everyone else.

features.title: A booking flow that actually knows your passport
features.intro: Every feature is built for the Australia to Asia corridor - not retrofitted from a Western leisure template.

items.title: Visa-aware search
items.body: Enter your passport once. Every fare is screened for transit-visa risk and destination eligibility before it's shown - so the cheapest option is always one you can actually fly.

items.title: Transparent all-in pricing
items.body: The price you see is the price you pay - taxes, fees, and card surcharge included, up front. ACL-aligned, no checkout-stage surprises.

items.title: Bilingual + local payments
items.body: Interface in English, Hindi, Mandarin and Vietnamese. Pay your way - WeChat Pay, Alipay, UPI, and Australian cards.

items.title: Student discounts + pay-later
items.body: Verify with a .edu email or student ID for member fares, baggage credits, and interest-free pay-later on term-break trips.

items.title: Bundled insurance & eSIM
items.body: Add travel insurance and a destination eSIM in the same checkout - no third-party detours. One itinerary, one support contact, one price.

items.title: Community-native deals
items.body: Bilingual deal-alert newsletter plus WhatsApp / WeChat / Discord communities surface fares the moment they drop - the low-CAC model, rebuilt for these corridors.

how.title: Three steps to a fare you can actually use
how.intro: From search to boarding in minutes - no spreadsheets, no embassy guesswork, no checkout surprises.

steps.title: Search with your passport

steps.title: See visa-eligible cheapest fares

steps.title: Book + add insurance & eSIM

items.a: You enter your passport once. Before any fare is shown, Routebird screens it for whether you're eligible to enter the destination, and whether you'd need a transit visa for any layover city. Fares you can't legally fly are filtered or clearly flagged.

items.q: Which passports do you support at launch?
items.a: Launch focus is the corridors our community flies most: Indian, Chinese, Vietnamese, Filipino, and Nepalese passports on Australia to India / China / SEA routes.

items.q: Is Routebird a real booking platform or just a search engine?
items.a: A real OTA. We issue live flight tickets via Duffel (merchant of record, so we don't need an IATA number to start) and attach hotels, insurance, and eSIM through affiliate supply.
We're in early access now. The waitlist gets the first invites to the MVP ahead of public launch.
Every fare shown includes taxes, airline fees, and our card-surcharge estimate - the number you see is what you pay.

items.q: Is Routebird a licensed travel agent?
items.a: Australia has had no mandatory travel-agent licence since 2014. ATAS accreditation is voluntary and planned as we scale. We operate under the Australian Consumer Law.

finalCta.title: Be first to fly smarter
